paragraphs.text: Necrodermis counters are a type of counter introduced in the Warhammer 40,000 . They mark revived creatures from the graveyard as artifact creatures .

Necrodermis counters first appeared on The War in Heaven in the Warhammer 40,000 . It is a Saga whose third Lore counter ability lets the player return a creature from the graveyard to the battlefield with a total mana value of 8 or less. They return to the battlefield as artifact creature in addition to their other types.
The addition of the artifact type is independent of the necrodermis counter; even if removed, the creature will remain an artifact.
